title: SHA-1 selected by name (r) — review required
description: Security code in r selects SHA-1 by algorithm name: digest(x, algo="sha1"). Collision attacks ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity. This lexical rule flags the selection; the reviewer confirms the use is legacy interop or upgrades it.
remediation: Select algo="sha256" instead of SHA-1 for any security purpose.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the SHA-1 name regardless of purpose. Call-shaped SHA-1 uses are separate rules.
